items.title: Le Marais & the Islands, into the evening
items.purpose: Historic Paris and the Seine — context before any giant museum.

stops.name: Café Hugo
stops.description: Slow start under the arcades. The corner table I always end up at — order the *tartine* and watch the square wake up.
stops.evidence: Marked firsthand in the catalog · archive image unavailable

stops.name: Place des Vosges
stops.description: A full loop of the arcades, then the garden. My most-shot place in the city — I've never once walked through without stopping.
stops.evidence: Firsthand archive · Oct 2016 · Jun 2026 · historical visit, not current operating information

stops.name: Rue des Rosiers
stops.description: Falafel in hand, eaten leaning on whatever wall has sun — the line at the green storefront moves faster than it looks.
stops.evidence: Marked firsthand in the catalog · archive image unavailable

stops.name: Centre Pompidou
stops.description: The inside-out building, currently wrapped for its long renovation — which is its own kind of honest: pipes on pipes. The plateau out front still earns the detour.
stops.evidence: Firsthand archive · Dec 2024 · Jun 2026 · historical visit, not current operating information

stops.name: Notre-Dame
stops.description: Go early — the parvis before nine is almost private. Inside, the stone is *pale again* since the reopening; I finally have interior shots worth keeping.
stops.evidence: Firsthand archive · Jul 2024 – Jan 2025 · historical visit, not current operating information

stops.name: Square du Vert-Galant
stops.description: Down the steps behind the Pont Neuf statue — the prow of the island, water on both sides. Face west and let the boats slide past.
stops.evidence: Firsthand archive · Jul 2022 – Jun 2026 · historical visit, not current operating information

stops.name: Allard
stops.evidence: Web-researched experience · no firsthand archive evidence
